prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Einsteinium (Es) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a study or library in her element's kingdom
Time of day: late morning — clear fresh daylight, soft short shadows; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.

Outfit: a one-shoulder lounge top and matching soft pants — in muted olive green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with airy, slightly crumpled linen and a light fine-knit cardigan layered over it, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on the table, her elbow on the table.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds a small screwdriver at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — einsteinium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first found in the fallout of the first hydrogen-bomb test in late 1952 on a Pacific coral atoll, sifted from filter papers flown through the towering cloud and from scraps of the atoll's coral, born when uranium swallowed fifteen neutrons in a single instant; the find was kept secret for years, and she was named for the most famous physicist of the century, the genius of relativity; her best-known form glows a soft blue by its own radioactivity and is so fierce that it slowly shatters its own crystal structure, and only the tiniest amounts of her have ever been gathered — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
